what: Sunbelt Rentals rents construction and industrial equipment: diggers, lifts, generators, pumps and climate control units, from more than 1,600 stores across North America and the United Kingdom. It is the second-largest equipment rental company in North America.
customers: Construction contractors, industrial maintenance teams, event organisers, utilities and emergency response operations.
money: power, climate control, flooring, pumps and scaffolding
moat: Store density that puts equipment within a short drive of any job site, and a fleet large enough to absorb demand surges after storms or during large projects.
risks: Debt of about $11 billion against almost no cash
Construction activity is cyclical and non-residential building has slowed
Equipment purchase costs rose sharply with inflation
Revenue grew only about 3% last year
opportunities: Operating margin of 20% with large mega-projects such as chip plants and data centres under construction
Specialty rental earns higher margins and is growing faster than general tools
Contractors increasingly rent rather than own equipment, which expands the market
watch: Rental revenue growth and fleet utilisation.
